LESSON: PILLARS OF SWALAH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Pillars of Swalah
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Pillars of Swalah, part of Devotional Acts in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What do you recite when praying? 2. Which postures are performed in prayers?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. pick the pillars of swalah (niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, reciting al-Fatiha, rukuu, raising from rukuu, sujud, siting between the sujud, sitting while reciting the last tashahhud, tashahhud, prayers for Ibrahim, taslim, tumaninah, tartib) from a flash cards and arrange them in sequence,

2. discuss the pillars of swalah and write them in their notebook,

3. role-play the pillars of swalah, individually/in pairs/in groups,

4. watch a video clip of pillars of swalah on digital device,

5. demonstrate the pillars of swalah, individually/in pairs/in groups. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. pick the pillars of swalah (niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, reciting al-Fatiha, rukuu, raising from rukuu, sujud, siting between the sujud, sitting while reciting the last tashahhud, tashahhud, prayers for Ibrahim, taslim, tumaninah, tartib) from a flash cards and arrange them in sequence,
2. discuss the pillars of swalah and write them in their notebook,
3. role-play the pillars of swalah, individually/in pairs/in groups,
4. watch a video clip of pillars of swalah on digital device,
5. demonstrate the pillars of swalah, individually/in pairs/in groups. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Pillars of Swalah together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners discuss the pillars of swalah, in

pairs/groups, and be guided to write them in their notebook.

• Communication and collaboration: the skill of writing and speaking is enhanced as learners discuss the pillars of swalah, in

pairs/groups, and be guided to write them in their notebook

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners role-play the pillars of swalah, individually/in

pairs/in groups

Values:
• Responsibility: accountability enhanced as learners role-play the pillars of swalah, individually/in pairs/in groups.

• Unity: cooperation enhanced as learners demonstrate the pillars of swalah, in pairs/groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health issues: Postures of swalah prevent lifestyles diseases, which promotes good health.

Link to other Learning Areas: Creative Arts as learners perform the pillars of swalah, which is part of exercise.
